Author: NearVoice contributors; original by Ricimon
Name: NearVoice
Description: Automatic world/map proximity, quiet connection/map changes, bounded audio buffers, Turkish font and optional talking animation. 0.2.2 disables old default join/leave beeps once while preserving microphone and other settings. /yakin opens the panel.

Author: XeldarAlz; local Discord adaptation
Name: Aethr App (local Discord)
Punchline: Your existing phone interface with your Discord friends.
Description: Private local edition based on Aetherphone. Uses official Discord authorization for contacts and text chat. Aethernet services and unchecked native media/browser playback are disabled.

Author: YF
Name: Musical Guide (local camera R15)
Description: Brief tracking gaps preserve the calibrated center for up to one second. Three clean unique frames spanning at least sixty milliseconds are required before bounded look resumes. Long loss, source/session changes and camera ownership changes still require full calibration. Native camera guards, head position, mounts and hand clipping are preserved.
Punchline: Enhanced camera distance control and first-person experience.
Changelog: Normal update: signed lateral lip/jaw neutral; time-bounded expression median; preserve center across brief tracking loss. No native hook or paid sculpt changes; native game acceptance pending. https://github.com/SmolShar/NearVoice-Downloads/releases/tag/face-response-camera-r15-2026-10-23

Author: Risa and Contributors
Name: Customize+ (local NearFace fork)
Punchline: Customize your character beyond FFXIV's limitations.
Description: More visible bounded eyebrow, cheek puff and nose expressions; calibrated blink now includes matching squint/wide response. Existing eye opt-in, jaw/lip behavior and ownership remain. Native sculpt appearance pending.
Changelog: Normal update: optional10-60FPS with measured processing rate; stronger bounded brows/cheeks/nose; calibrated blink+squint response; explicit webcam look start. No new shortcuts/profiles. Native appearance and physical-camera performance pending. https://github.com/SmolShar/NearVoice-Downloads/releases/tag/face-visibility-camera-r14-2026-10-22

Name: NearFace (detailed face + small mirror)
